messages:
maria: 🚨 ACME reporting persistent 5xxs and auth failures hitting hosted inference in us-west-3 since ~07:30 PDT. Spike in 502/504 and auth retries. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/hosts/usw3-hosted-api (error-rate 4.8% p95 latency 1.2s). customer says billing jobs also failing.
alerts-bot: [ALERT] region=us-west-3 service=hosted-api severity=high metric=5xx_rate value=4.8% p95_latency=1.2s window=5m
sasha: I'm oncall for infra, grabbing traces + runbook. pinging eng-infra. runbook: https://confluence.redwood.local/triage/network-hosted-api
tony: quick triage: seeing packet loss and retransmits between our edge and ISP ASN 64512. traceroute to 52.34.12.56 (usw3 edge) shows ECMP hops flipping.
```
traceroute to 52.34.12.56 (52.34.12.56), 30 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1  10.0.0.1  0.9 ms
 2  198.51.100.1  5.2 ms
 3  * * *
 4  203.0.113.1  25.4 ms  25.6 ms  36.8 ms
 5  52.34.12.56  26.1 ms  120.5 ms  28.0 ms
```
diane: logs from auth proxy show token refresh succeeds then immediate 502 on next call: sample: `INFO token_refresh user=acme-app id=org-831; next_request -> 502 gateway_error` Also billing-worker job: `ERROR billing/charge sync failed: 502 gateway`
kevin: running tcpdump on edge now, command: `sudo tcpdump -i eth0 -w /tmp/usw3-flap.pcap host 52.34.12.56 and tcp` — capturing retransmits and occasional TCP RST bursts.
tony: provider BGP feed shows rapid AS path changes: AS64512 -> AS65123 -> AS64512 repeatedly, flap count 6 in 15m. opened provider ping and raised ticket with upstream. suspect multipath asymmetry causing stateful gateway failures. provider acknowledged.
maria: can we mitigate customer impact now? need short-term fallback for critical orgs (ACME billing).
sasha: applied smart-routing override: for org=acme-org-id prefer region us-west-2 (manual policy) with 15m TTL. also increased auth proxy timeout from 3s -> 8s and enabled exponential backoff for token validation retries. suppressed noisy alerts for this org. :white_check_mark:
alerts-bot: INFO: smart-routing change applied for acme-org-id (prefer=us-west-2 ttl=15m). monitor: acme 5xx_rate dropped to 0.4% within 5m.
diane: opened provider ticket PRV-84213, asking for root cause + mitigation. ETA vendor-estimate 45m. attaching pcap + bgp dumps.
maria: thanks team — CS informed ACME with interim mitigation and we promised updates. create postmortem once root cause confirmed.
sasha: drafting customer note and postmortem skeleton, cc: solutions-eng. Will follow up if flap persists. :ear_of_rice:
